title: Upgrade pypdf to 6.10.2 to resolve remaining Snyk vulnerabilities
description: Resolve remaining Snyk dependency findings SNYK-PYTHON-PYPDF-16097903, SNYK-PYTHON-PYPDF-16097899, and SNYK-PYTHON-PYPDF-16097901 by upgrading pypdf from 6.10.0 to 6.10.2 and validating lint/tests/snyk scan output.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Updated dependency floor to pypdf>=6.10.2 and regenerated poetry.lock. Verification: poetry check passes. Snyk scan (snyk test --all-projects) shows Python/poetry project has no vulnerable paths; remaining findings are in apps/dashboard npm dependency tree (lodash via aws-amplify notifications).

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Cross-check after dashboard remediation: snyk test --all-projects now reports no vulnerable paths in all scanned projects (poetry + dashboard + amplify + reinforcement-memory). pypdf upgrade remains in this change set and validates clean.
